name: Antigravity CLI
description: Runs Google's Antigravity CLI (agy) as a subscription-backed model provider.

providerAuthChoices.choiceHint: Use an existing Antigravity CLI (agy) login on this host. Run `agy models` to confirm.

command.label: agy binary
command.help: Path to the agy executable. Prefer an absolute path after install; default `agy` resolves via PATH.

mode.label: agy mode
mode.help: Value for `agy --mode` on print-mode runs, or `none` to omit the flag.

skipPermissions.label: Skip permissions
skipPermissions.help: Passes --dangerously-skip-permissions to agy. Off by default. Only enable if you accept tool runs without agy permission prompts.
